title: Siege of Port-au-Prince (1793)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Port-au-Prince (1793)", at revision 1370744538, opens: "The siege of Port-au-Prince took place in April 1793 during the Haitian Revolution." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3485993, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1793 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
